messages.subject: Conway Maxwell Poisson distribution
parts:
Hi all,

I would like to know if it is possible to define in R-inla a hurdle model with a binomial-truncated Conway Maxwell Poisson distribution.
Th package has already implemented the type 0 zero inflated poisson, so I think it might be possible to define a type 0 zero inflated Conway Maxwell Poisson.

Thanks.

messages.author: 6e7fe337c35104b0
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Conway Maxwell Poisson distribution
parts: Hi, it's not so simple. Because, the probability mass function of the COM-Poisson distribution must compute an infinite sum (Z(lambda, phi)). I did this model in my undergraduate thesis (in Portuguese), for a quick view see slide 15 of my presentation (https://jreduardo.github.io/monografia/slides-tcc.pdf). This approach is based on hurdle models, there is a zero-inflated COM-Poisson proposed by Kimberly Sellers (2016) as another alternative (http://faculty.georgetown.edu/kfs7/MY%20PUBLICATIONS/SellersAndRaim2016CSDA.pdf).
